title: pleurothallis centranthera
intro: Pleurothallis centranthera, commonly known as the Pleurothallis orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Pleurothallis centranthera include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
